purpose: readiness preflight only; never formal qualification
separation_rule: Preflight plaintext cases and gold must not exist in the repository during implementation. After temporary implementation freeze, a CI job must generate one set from a fresh cryptographic random seed, evaluate it in the same job, retain only hashes/aggregate metrics in logs, and seal the full cases+gold+outputs as a restricted workflow artifact. The assistant must not inspect individual preflight cases or gold before/during execution.
failure_policy: If readiness misses, expose only aggregate/general failure categories; do not inspect or tune to individual sealed cases. Return to visible development and require a newly generated independently seeded preflight before another preflight.
formal_qualification_independence: Passing preflight does not authorize calling this set formal qualification. Formal qualification requires a separate fresh untouched dataset.
